$comment: Pack Rat <data>/house-claims.json v1 (issue #299): the houses the player claimed, a JSON list written by the app (app/store/house-claims.mts) and by TazUO's packrat-panel.py (Claim this house), and read by both and by the TazUO scanners (adapters/_shared/tazuo/claims.py). Restricted to the keyword subset app/schema/validate.mts supports. A reader keeps the entries that pass and drops the rest, the first 500, from a file of at most 256 KiB. One rule this schema can't say is checked beside it on both sides: a claim's bounds run from x0 <= x1 and y0 <= y1. The shared accept and reject cases are app/fixtures/contract-cases/house-claims.json, which the TypeScript and Python test suites both run.

id.$comment: the house's id, <facet or x>-<x>-<y> of its corner tile (app/house-names.mts's isHouseId)

facet.$comment: null when the facet was not known

by.$comment: the character that claimed it; left out of the claims the app makes itself
